lines.en: I walk into the village through the dew.
Only my footsteps in the fog.
I walk where no one has walked.
No other footprints on the ground.
The fog's too bright; I hide deeper in.
In sunlight, I narrow my eyes.
I sniff the warmth inside the fog.

lines.zh: 这片空世界里只剩我和它。
lines.en: In this empty world only it and I remain.
When you turn, I am under the lamp.

lines.zh: 这世界空了，只剩我们两个。
lines.en: The world is empty; only we two remain.
My claws dig into the mud.
I followed you three miles through the fog.
My blood drips onto the dry grass.
I retreat into the fog to lick my wounds.
I call into the fog and no one answers.
A strip of my hide is gone.
Not yet; I am still here.
You have my food on you.
Give me the deliciousness on you.
Follow me, I can give you more.
Don't run, I won't hurt you.

lines.zh: 这个世界空了，只剩我们两个。
lines.en: The world's empty — only the two of us left.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，现在尝尝我的攻击！
lines.en: You blocked my path, now feel my attack!
You blocked me, I'm going to attack!
Get out of the way, I'll hurt you!

lines.zh: 这世界只剩我们两个，挤什么。
lines.en: Only the two of us are left here. Why crowd?
Move. The sunlight is chasing me.
Move, I have an important matter!

lines.zh: 让我过去，我有东西要拿！
lines.en: Let me pass, I need something!
Get out of my way, I have a mission!

lines.zh: 这个世界空了，只剩我们。
lines.en: The world is empty. Only we remain.

lines.zh: 你很适合成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: You would make a good mate.

lines.zh: 一起繁衍后代吧，这样我们才能生存。
lines.en: Let's reproduce, we need to survive.

lines.zh: 找一个温暖的地方，开始我们的后代。
lines.en: Find a warm place, let's start our offspring.

lines.zh: 我们找个地方，开始我们的下一代。
lines.en: Let's find a place, start our next generation.

lines.zh: 你适合成为我的伴侣，一起繁衍。
lines.en: You suit me as a mate, let's reproduce.

lines.zh: 让我们一起开始一个新生命。
lines.en: Let's start a new life together.

lines.zh: 一起繁衍后代，才能确保我们的未来。
lines.en: Let's reproduce to ensure our future.

lines.zh: 找一个温暖的地方，开始繁衍吧。
lines.en: Find a warm place, let's start reproducing.

lines.zh: 繁衍后代，是我们的责任。

lines.en: I pick up the carrion and drop it.
Stares at the bone in your hand.

lines.zh: 贪婪地啃食你的残羹剩饭。

lines.en: I slip along the wall to your back.

lines.zh: 这块清空的世界，我盯上你了。
lines.en: In this emptied world, I've picked you.
The fog thinned a hair, and I found you.

lines.zh: 雾里除了我，确实没有别人。
lines.en: Besides me, there really is no one in the fog.
The fog brings me behind you.

lines.zh: 你听见的第二种脚步是我。
lines.en: The second set of steps is mine.
When the light dies, I move.
Your breathing is loud in the fog.
I have followed you from far away.
Rips at you with its teeth.

lines.zh: 我停在你一臂之外不动。
lines.en: I stop one arm's length away.
My hand rises behind your shoulder.
Your neck shows above your collar.
I wait for you to lower your weapon.
This lamp will not save you.
My teeth sink into your sleeve.
You can't avoid me now, eat it!
My claw lands on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一口咬碎了你的护腕。
这片雾里，只有我一个在走。
lines.en: In this fog, only I walk.
The smell of your blood makes me hungrier.
Rip you apart with my claws!

lines.zh: 这世界空了，只剩我和另一只。
lines.en: The world emptied; only me and one other left.

lines.zh: 雾里伸出的手抓住了你！
lines.en: A hand from the fog grabs you!

lines.zh: 这一下替我熬过的白天。
lines.en: This blow is for the daylight I endured.
Your blood is warm in the fog.
Don't shout; no one will come.
I pin you to the cold ground!
Now it is your turn to fear.

lines.zh: 这世界本来就不该有你。
lines.en: This world never should have had you.

lines.zh: 雾起来时我从土里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl from the soil when the fog rises.

lines.zh: 这个世界没有人，除了我。
lines.en: There's no one in this world but me.
The lone creature in the dark...

lines.zh: 空荡的世界上多了一个影子。
lines.en: One more shadow in the empty world.
When the lamps die, I am awake.
Are you sure you are alone here?
Water pours into my hollow chest.
The blast throws me into the fog.
Something struck me in the fog.
I am hungry enough to gnaw my own claws.
Down in the void is quieter than here.
